source_version: Capella (continuously deployed, no discrete version number)

concepts.label: Eventing Service
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - this batch's page explicitly frames it as 'the Eventing Service' (parallel to Data/Query/Index/Search/Analytics Service), yet no service:eventing-service concept existed anywhere in the registry before this batch - confirms this batch's specific hypothesis that Eventing had not previously come up

notable_absence.finding: Directly answers this batch's hypothesis question: this page is a flat list of eventing_* Prometheus metric names (dcp_backlog, bkt_ops_cas_mismatch_count, analytics_op_exception_count, etc.) with version badges and one-line descriptions - no service-dependency prose. However, several metric names themselves hint at runtime dependencies not stated in prose: eventing_bkt_ops_cas_mismatch_count and eventing_bucket_op_exception_count imply Key-Value/Data-Service interaction, and eventing_analytics_op_exception_count implies Analytics-Service interaction, but these are metric-naming artifacts, not documented 'depends on service' statements - so no dependsOnService relation could be extracted with verbatim textual evidence, even though the metric names are suggestive.

cross_component_finding: This is the first page across all extraction rounds to establish service:eventing-service as a concept. It should be added to the service: namespace family alongside service:query-service/index-service/data-service/search-service/analytics-service.
